verdict.rationale: GA4's own docs say Data API v1 includes funnel reporting, and a community user notes custom reports can be built in the 'Explore' UI, so funnel analysis is a documented product capability. The documented funnel path is API-based, though, and community users describe the interface as over-complex and "aimed at data scientists," which weakens the founder-without-an-analyst part of the story. missing for 10: first-party docs for UI-based funnel exploration with step-by-step drop-off visualization, evidence that a non-analyst founder can build activation funnels unaided, hands-on corroboration of funnel/drop-off workflows.
